scope: AG05 local UI and lab visual review; not manual participant UAT
result: No new actionable visual defect observed in the eight reviewed captures.
implementationSources: Actual AppShell, A2ChatCoach, A2ReviewedPlan, A2PlanEvidenceReview, shared contracts and repository Tailwind/CSS.

observations: Los registros de A3 y la declaración de A4 son legibles, con enlaces internos y etiquetas que limitan su significado.
La fecha elegida de revisión se distingue de la actualización del registro; el editor conserva su propósito y un control enfocado visible.
El aviso de cambio, el nuevo texto de la fuente y el borrador conservado aparecen juntos.
La confirmación de nueva revisión está separada de Guardar y activar plan, que aparece deshabilitado hasta reconocer el contexto.
La imposibilidad de recuperar A3 se comunica sin presentarla como ausencia de registros.
La declaración disponible de A4, el plan guardado y el borrador permanecen visibles; la nueva confirmación está deshabilitada.
El panel presenta las dos fuentes profesionales como no aplicables y conserva el foco de la práctica personal.
No muestra respuestas A3, decisiones A4 ni enlaces a sus registros en el panel.

limitations: Each of the eight axe audits has color-contrast in incomplete. Visual inspection does not resolve those algorithmic results or certify WCAG conformance.

Full-page screenshots were captured after keyboard interaction and scrolling. Fixed AppShell and skip-link controls appear at the scrolled viewport position within the full document image; this is not an unscrolled page composition.

Desktop sidebar access is a synthetic fixture and retains a locked A4 item while separate synthetic plan fixtures provide A4 data. These captures do not establish server authorization or real sidebar/evidence consistency.
Arial and Georgia system fonts were used; the native date input follows this browser locale. Other fonts, browsers, devices, zoom levels and assistive technologies were not visually assessed here.
Expanded details intentionally show all source excerpts; normal collapsed presentation and usefulness to participants require separate product evaluation.
No real Supabase Auth, persistence, RLS, model/provider, production state, hosted UAT or manual participant case was validated by this local harness.
The review does not close AG05. Participant usefulness and model behavior remain separate evidence requirements.
